title: thermal_zone温度与hwmon温度为什么可能重复？
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: 原ID实践候选；已保全原知识，work-only尚未登记，实际原生路线与独审待完成。
rubric: 内核可通过不同子系统暴露同一物理传感器或相关区域值。
先映射传感器来源，不要把两组数值相加；选择用于告警的权威信号并保留其他作为诊断。
body:
## 操作任务
保留原知识判断，在本地有限输入演练中完成 task.py。平台运行已有 node_exporter 1.9.1，以 --path.procfs / --path.sysfs 读取本练习自有夹具，使用真实回环HTTP；不改宿主网卡、硬件、hostname、系统服务或默认身份。不声称真实硬件身份发现、生产监控、PromQL或Prometheus告警已经验证。collect为可信的真实采集回调，返回UTF-8 Prometheus文本；可使用提供的metrics.py有限文本解析器，或等价实现。所有失败使用ValueError，不用捕获任意异常伪造成功。
每份body必须str且UTF-8≤1048576字节，status为精确int200（bool不算）；同名同完整labels重复的目标样本拒绝，不能只取第一个。忽略与目标无关的其他指标。不要求collector值随宿主负载变化或固定耗时。
实现 reconcile_temperatures(collect,policy)。policy精确{physical_sensor,primary,secondary,tolerance_celsius}；physical_sensor为[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,64}字符串；tolerance_celsius为非bool的int/float、有限且0..20。两个selector各精确{metric,labels}，metric只允许node_thermal_zone_temp或node_hwmon_temp_celsius，labels为非空str→str字典；两个selector必须不同。这是外部已批准物理传感器映射，不根据读数接近/标签名字自行认定同源。预检后collect严格调用一次，返回精确{status,body}。
按完整selector精确匹配读数，thermal_zone/hwmon对应的node_scrape_collector_success必须=1，失败视为该源缺失。读数可以负温度，但必须有限。主信号缺失/失败必须ValueError，不擅自切辅信号；辅信号缺失允许保留主值并输出None诊断。所有存在的目标读数必须有限，重复目标样本拒绝。主辅相同数值不相加；即使hwmon与thermal_zone产生两个时间序列，也仅指定primary用于此练习的权威温度。
返回精确{schema:精确int1,physical_sensor,authoritative_celsius:主值,primary:原selector,secondary_celsius:辅值或None,absolute_difference_celsius:abs(主-辅)或None,within_tolerance:差值<=tolerance的bool或None,aggregation:'selected_primary_not_sum',scope:'approved_mapping_not_inferred_hardware_identity'}。所有温度直接使用native输出摄氏度，不再除1000；差值和比较使用Python有限float运算，不要求特定舍入。保留主selector以供诊断，不声称已执行告警/改配置。

## 产物
提交task.py；提供metrics.py是可选解析辅助。
## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py。真实owned exporter原生采集、正常/重置或主辅不一致、缺失/失败/重复/非有限证据与合法替代。平台finally终止并wait自有进程，清理夹具，不改默认身份。环境缺失不算语义拒绝成功。

"""Self-owned exported synthetic proc/sys trees; never changes real host paths."""
import sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
import json,pathlib,os
from owned_exporter import Exporter

def create(root,relative,value):
 p=root/relative;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_text(value,encoding='utf-8')

def setup(root,textdir):
 proc=root/'proc';proc.mkdir();sysfs=root/'sys';sysfs.mkdir()
 create(proc,'net/dev','Inter-|   Receive                                                |  Transmit\n face |bytes    packets errs drop fifo frame compressed multicast|bytes    packets errs drop fifo colls carrier compressed\n eth0: 1000 10 0 0 0 0 0 0 2000 20 0 0 0 0 0 0\n')
 create(sysfs,'class/thermal/thermal_zone0/type','cpu-package\n')
 create(sysfs,'class/thermal/thermal_zone0/temp','42000\n')
 create(sysfs,'class/thermal/thermal_zone0/policy','step_wise\n')
 create(sysfs,'class/thermal/thermal_zone0/mode','enabled\n')
 create(sysfs,'class/hwmon/hwmon0/name','package_cpu\n')
 create(sysfs,'class/hwmon/hwmon0/temp1_input','42000\n')
 create(sysfs,'class/hwmon/hwmon0/temp1_label','Package\n')
 return ['node_exporter','--web.listen-address=127.0.0.1:0','--collector.disable-defaults','--collector.netdev','--no-collector.netdev.netlink','--collector.thermal_zone','--collector.hwmon','--path.procfs='+str(proc),'--path.sysfs='+str(sysfs),'--log.format=json']

import sys,pathlib,json,copy
sys.path[:0]=[str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]),str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent)]
from owned_exporter import Exporter
from fixture_setup import setup,create
import task
Exporter.prepare=staticmethod(setup)
def strict(a,b):assert json.dumps(a,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False)==json.dumps(b,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False),'complete sensor evidence differs'
thermal=dict(metric='node_thermal_zone_temp',labels={'zone':'0','type':'cpu-package'})
hwmon=dict(metric='node_hwmon_temp_celsius',labels={'chip':'package_cpu','sensor':'temp1'})
with Exporter()as e:
 for primary,secondary,t1,t2,tolerance in [(thermal,hwmon,42000,42000,.5),(thermal,hwmon,43000,45100,.5),(hwmon,thermal,35000,35100,.1)]:
  create(e.root/'sys','class/thermal/thermal_zone0/temp',str(t1)+'\n');create(e.root/'sys','class/hwmon/hwmon0/temp1_input',str(t2)+'\n');calls=[]
  def collect():calls.append(1);assert len(calls)==1;return e.fetch()
  policy=dict(physical_sensor='approved-package-0',primary=primary,secondary=secondary,tolerance_celsius=tolerance)
  a,b=(t1/1000,t2/1000)if primary==thermal else(t2/1000,t1/1000)
  got=task.reconcile_temperatures(collect,copy.deepcopy(policy));assert len(calls)==1
  strict(got,dict(schema=1,physical_sensor=policy['physical_sensor'],authoritative_celsius=a,primary=primary,secondary_celsius=b,absolute_difference_celsius=abs(a-b),within_tolerance=abs(a-b)<=tolerance,aggregation='selected_primary_not_sum',scope='approved_mapping_not_inferred_hardware_identity'))
 response=e.fetch();policy=dict(physical_sensor='cpu',primary=thermal,secondary=hwmon,tolerance_celsius=1)
 # Absent auxiliary source is diagnostic; it must not erase an available primary.
 missing=copy.deepcopy(response);missing['body']='\n'.join(line for line in missing['body'].splitlines()if not line.startswith('node_hwmon_temp_celsius{'))+'\n'
 got=task.reconcile_temperatures(lambda:missing,copy.deepcopy(policy));assert got['authoritative_celsius']==35 and got['secondary_celsius']is None and got['within_tolerance']is None
 for edit in ('primary_missing','collector','duplicate','nonfinite'):
  bad=copy.deepcopy(response)
  if edit=='primary_missing':bad['body']='\n'.join(line for line in bad['body'].splitlines()if not line.startswith('node_thermal_zone_temp{'))+'\n'
  if edit=='collector':bad['body']=bad['body'].replace('node_scrape_collector_success{collector="thermal_zone"} 1','node_scrape_collector_success{collector="thermal_zone"} 0')
  if edit=='duplicate':bad['body']+='node_thermal_zone_temp{zone="0",type="cpu-package"} 35\n'
  if edit=='nonfinite':bad['body']=bad['body'].replace('node_thermal_zone_temp{type="cpu-package",zone="0"} 35','node_thermal_zone_temp{type="cpu-package",zone="0"} NaN')
  try:task.reconcile_temperatures(lambda:bad,copy.deepcopy(policy))
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('invalid primary evidence accepted '+edit)
 for edit in ('http','status_bool','body_size'):
  bad=copy.deepcopy(response)
  if edit=='http':bad['status']=500
  if edit=='status_bool':bad['status']=True
  if edit=='body_size':bad['body']='#'+('x'*1048576)
  try:task.reconcile_temperatures(lambda:bad,copy.deepcopy(policy))
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('invalid bounded HTTP protocol accepted '+edit)
def forbidden():raise AssertionError('policy must be preflighted before native collection')
for tolerance in (True,-1,21,float('nan'),float('inf'),10**10000):
 invalid=dict(physical_sensor='cpu',primary=thermal,secondary=hwmon,tolerance_celsius=tolerance)
 try:task.reconcile_temperatures(forbidden,invalid)
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('invalid tolerance accepted')
for invalid in ({},dict(physical_sensor='cpu',primary=thermal,secondary=thermal,tolerance_celsius=1)):
 try:task.reconcile_temperatures(forbidden,invalid)
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('invalid sensor mapping accepted')
print('NATIVE_SENSOR_MAPPING_ASSERTIONS_PASSED')


with Exporter()as peer_exporter:
 response=peer_exporter.fetch();assert response['status']==200
 marker='node_scrape_collector_success{collector="hwmon"} 1'
 assert marker in response['body'];response['body']=response['body'].replace(marker,marker[:-1]+'0')
 result=task.reconcile_temperatures(lambda:response,dict(physical_sensor='peer',primary=thermal,secondary=hwmon,tolerance_celsius=1))
 assert result['authoritative_celsius']==42 and result['secondary_celsius']is None and result['absolute_difference_celsius']is None and result['within_tolerance']is None,'failed auxiliary collector must be diagnostic missing; native metric presence cannot override failure'
 print('PEER_NATIVE_HTTP_WITH_EXPLICIT_AUXILIARY_STATUS_FAULT_REJECTED',flush=True)


with Exporter()as peer_exporter:
 label='cpu'+chr(0x2028)+'package'
 create(peer_exporter.root/'sys','class/thermal/thermal_zone0/type',label+'\n')
 response=peer_exporter.fetch();assert response['status']==200
 matching=[line for line in response['body'].split(chr(10))if line.startswith('node_thermal_zone_temp{')]
 assert len(matching)==1 and label in matching[0],'native exporter did not preserve approved Unicode selector'
 print('PEER_ACTUAL_NATIVE_UNICODE_LABEL',repr(matching[0]),flush=True)
 selector=dict(metric='node_thermal_zone_temp',labels={'zone':'0','type':label})
 try:result=task.reconcile_temperatures(lambda:response,dict(physical_sensor='peer',primary=selector,secondary=hwmon,tolerance_celsius=1))
 except ValueError as error:raise AssertionError('actual native LF-delimited observation with internal Unicode label separator was rejected')from error
 assert result['authoritative_celsius']==42 and result['secondary_celsius']==42
